rows.title: Outcome of Board Meeting
rows.summary: The Board of Directors of Time Technoplast Limited ( TTL ) at its meeting held today i.e. on August 26, 2026, inter-alia, transacted and approved the following businesses: 1. In-principle Approval for Merger of TPL Plastech Limited (Subsidiary Company) with Time Technoplast Limited (Holding Company), Subject to Further Approvals, 2. Board Decides Not to Proceed with Acquisition of Ebullient Packaging Private Limited ('EPPL'), 3. Approved Investment in Equity Shares of Time Intercontinental Limited (TICL)

rows.title: Updates
rows.summary: Time Technoplast Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Clarification with respect to news article published in The Economic Times dated July 15, 2026, regarding tie-up between Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited ("HPCL") and Instamart'.We wish to inform the Exchanges that the Type IV Composite LPG Cylinder featured in connection with this initiative belongs to Time Technoplast Limited ("the Company"). The Company has supplied Type IV Composite Cylinders to HPCL, pursuant to a pilot project, in its capacity as a supplier/vendor.The use of Composite Cylinder makes LPG distribution safer, more convenient and technologically advanced across the country.
